levels.surface: أحمد بن محمّد بن يحيى العطّار

notes: al-Faqih's statement of his route to a book, with no saying (rule 11): the opening «عن اميّة بن عمرو، عن الشعيريّ» is the book's own source line and is not read as links
the route is read from «رويته عن» onward; the blessing «رضي اللّه عنه» is left out
